# 2 bedroom flat for sale

> RETIRE IN STYLE - A well-presented ground floor apartment, occupying one of the most convenient positions within the highly regarded Lydgate Court development, designed exclusively for the over 55s. Set at the end of the building, close to the rear entrance and residents’ parking, the apartment also enjoys a pleasant outlook over its own attractive section of communal gardens.
